nodes.label: Pulseboard
nodes.rationale: One tool that diagnoses connected social accounts and creates/publishes content informed by niche patterns — not five tabs across Buffer, Hootsuite, and native apps.

nodes.label: PlatformAdapter
nodes.rationale: Core talks only to PlatformAdapter; new networks are new adapter modules — do not rewrite core.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM
nodes.rationale: Only allowed algorithm for encrypting tokens/secrets at rest; never SHA as encryption.

nodes.label: Argon2id
nodes.rationale: Preferred password storage algorithm; bcrypt acceptable fallback; never AES so passwords can be decrypted.

nodes.label: Email + Password Auth
nodes.rationale: Magic link deferred; password auth locked for V1 with Argon2id/bcrypt and secure sessions.

nodes.label: Overview
nodes.rationale: North star: within 30 seconds know what's broken, what's working, what to post next — act without leaving Pulseboard.

nodes.label: MetricSnapshot
nodes.rationale: Point-in-time metrics for trends; one pull ≠ trend; snapshots required as source of truth for Overview reads.

nodes.label: MITRE ATT&CK
nodes.rationale: Map controls to ATT&CK — what would an adversary try; every phase exit reports tactics touched, controls shipped, residual risk.

nodes.label: S1 Success Bar
nodes.rationale: Hard priority: S1 analytics signal before S3 create/publish.

nodes.label: Selective 3D Mixture UI
nodes.rationale: ~80% clear 2D product UI + ~20% intentional 3D/depth; not flat spreadsheet, not pure WebGL toy.

nodes.label: Zero-Cost V1 Path
nodes.rationale: Zero-cost V1 first; platforms step-by-step; security every phase; paid APIs require Human approval.

nodes.label: RateLimiter
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 memory Map impl; later swap to Redis — forbid hardcoding Map rate limits inside handlers.

nodes.label: CacheStore
nodes.rationale: Memory + TTL in Phase 0; Redis/KV later; cache keys always include userId.

nodes.label: JobQueue
nodes.rationale: DB/no-op stub in Phase 0; later BullMQ/Inngest/Cloud Tasks; HTTP enqueues, workers call PlatformAdapter.

nodes.label: Clock
nodes.rationale: SystemClock in Phase 0; Test clock for deterministic tests.

nodes.label: Read vs Write Path
nodes.rationale: WRITE: Job→Adapter.fetch→normalize→upsert Post→MetricSnapshot→cache invalidate. READ: Overview→Prisma(snapshots)+formulas→NEVER Adapter.fetch.

nodes.label: Upgrade Ladder
nodes.rationale: Post-S6 metrics-gated: fix queries→vertical DB→pool→concurrency caps→workers→Redis→queue→replicas; never jump to Redis to paper over N+1.

nodes.label: Scalability Seams Principle
nodes.rationale: $0 V1 stays simple; scale via seams + invariants, not Redis/K8s on day one; nothing paints into a single-instance corner.

nodes.label: Pulseboard Palette
nodes.rationale: Calm signal-board mood; chalk/ink/pulse-teal; light-first; avoid SaaS purple and cream-terracotta.

nodes.label: Signal-Stack Hero
nodes.rationale: Landing first viewport: brand → one-liner → support → CTA pair → dominant 3D signal-stack; no badges/stats/overlays.

nodes.label: Master AI Builder Rules
nodes.rationale: One phase at a time; restate Build/Security/Tests/inputs; stop at phase boundary; never build before Human says run Phase N.
